activities.activity: Working the overnight shift at the aged-care residence, assisting residents with personal care, repositioning, fluid monitoring and writing up handover notes in the care log
Commuting home from the aged-care facility by train and bus, reading over the shift notes on the phone and keeping to the usual route
Making a light post-shift breakfast of toast and a pot of tea, keeping noise low and putting the few used items straight into the dishwasher
Taking a warm shower and changing out of work clothes to wind down before sleeping
Sleeping after the night shift with the fan on for white noise, phone set to silent and a written note on the door asking for quiet
Waking up slowly, boiling the kettle and preparing a simple flexitarian late lunch of rice, vegetables and egg, eating alone at the table
Sorting and loading a load of washing into the washing machine and setting the cycle
Folding dry laundry, tidying the desk and checking the written weekly reminder list on the desk to plan the rest of the day
Studying at the desk with the desk lamp on, reading social work course materials on the computer and typing up notes on the monitor
Cooking a batch of flexitarian dinner on the induction cooker, then eating the meal at the kitchen table with a cup of tea
Washing up, loading the dishwasher, wiping the benches and putting the leftovers into labelled containers in the refrigerator
Moving the washed laundry into the clothes dryer and switching on the dehumidifier
Writing quiet text messages to confirm weekend plans in advance, counting out the weekly cash budget and updating the written bill schedule
Relaxing on the bed watching a documentary on the computer and looking at the photo of the family dog in China
Brushing teeth and washing up for bed, then collecting the dried clothes to fold later
Reading a library book under the desk lamp and setting phone alarms and reminders for the next rostered shift
Sleeping with the fan running, curtain closed and phone on silent for the rest of the night
